findings.text: The company was incorporated on 11 October 2006 and ceased on 27 August 2010, at an age of 3.9 years (1416 days).
The company's status is recorded as dissolved, and it is flagged as a high-severity red flag by the rules.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
No charges are registered against the company.
Three current officers are recorded: two directors, PERSON 357 and PERSON 358, both appointed on 8 January 2007, and one other officer.
Neither director has other appointments on record, and across the two current directors checked no other companies were found.
The accounts and the confirmation statement are recorded as being of unknown overdue status, with no next due date or last made-up-to date recorded.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 467 (91000468) is recorded as dissolved, having ceased on 27 August 2010, with no insolvency record held by Companies House.
